bsi_ttclub_verbatim_quote: Maritime risks escalated sharply with the resurgence of sea piracy across Asian waters. Incidents rose by 85% in the first half of 2025, reaching their highest levels in nearly a decade, with the Strait of Malacca and Singapore experiencing a 281% year over year surge. While large cargo losses were rare due to strong shipboard security measures, thieves frequently stole engine spares, ship stores, and other unsecured items. Economic hardship and inconsistent enforcement contributed to this resurgence, though targeted arrests in Indonesia helped moderate activity later in the year.
